changes.summary: m3-assessment-1 binds the typed calculator assessment to a derived assertion. Scored, pending-review and unscored results distinguish adopted scores from draft arithmetic and carry bounds, robustness, missing or interrupted inputs and the projection digest. Empty inputs are valid only for an unscored assessment naming missing indicators.
